about_the_game:
The story isn’t over—it's only just beginning. This DLC for Hidden Portals: Eternal Balance brings you even deeper into the mysterious world of Luminaria with four all-new bonus locations. Packed with fresh hidden object scenes, clever mini-games, and layered lore, this expansion offers everything players love—plus secrets that change what you thought you knew.

Explore ancient ruins, forgotten records, celestial marvels, and dormant magic as you uncover the forces behind the Clock of Harmony and the delicate thread of time. Your journey to restore balance continues—are you ready to see what lies beyond the portal?

🕳 The Ancient Archive!

Search through a vast trove of crumbling scrolls and hidden texts to uncover forgotten truths about Luminaria’s history. Every dusty corner may hold a vital clue.

🕳 The Temple of Shadows!

Step into a sacred place where echoes of the past reveal secrets about the Clock of Harmony—and your family’s hidden connection to it.

🕳 The Lantern of Light!

Reignite a magical Fresnel lantern by solving maintenance puzzles and collecting rare components. Bring light back to what’s been left in darkness.

🕳 The Ancient Observatory!

Marvel at lost technology and uncover the celestial wisdom of a vanished civilization. Could this hold the key to Lira’s fate—and the origin of time itself?

It’s an essential chapter for those who crave more mystery, more depth, and more of Luminaria’s haunting beauty. Step beyond the known paths, and uncover what was meant to stay hidden.
